items.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the automatic transmission
items.job: Replace radiator; rebuild or replace transmission if contaminated
items.note: Aftermarket radiator for the 2005–2010 4.0L automatic is about $180 (go-parts). Owners report $3,800–4,100 on average when the transmission is also ruined.
